CustomField.description: Stamped by AF_FL_Quote_SetDiscountApprovalStatus from the AF_DiscountApprovalTier__mdt record whose Min/Max Percent band contains AF_DiscountPercent__c. Quote.AF_AP_Quote_DiscountTiers routes on this stable number (0=self-authorized, 1=Showroom Manager, 2=Sales/Brand Manager, 3=General Manager, 4=CEO), not on the raw percentage, so the business can edit the % boundaries in AF_DiscountApprovalTier__mdt without any Flow/Approval Process change.
CustomField.label: Discount Tier
